title: Conditional κ = 0.003645669928698 (+1.96706982e-7 over #7274): terminal-cut rechart
body:

Regenerating and billing all transports gives native `T8 −2, T9 +2; P1 −1, P4 −3, P5 +3`. The complete invoice has 22,461 productive positions, 110,536 paid positions, S = 1,424 and no empty-root credit.

Signed ordinary cost is 782,522,276 < 10^9; precision coefficient is 2,430.

**All four registered commands passed against 23 unchanged scientific files.** The first invocation passed early/native, then a sparse-checkout update omitted `RESULT.json` during the caller's final receipt comparison. After byte-identical restoration, caller and frontier were rerun through the repository's same metadata validator, isolated interpreter and timeout runner. Every frozen receipt matched. `REPLAY.txt` preserves the interruption and successful resume; this is not claimed as one uninterrupted runner invocation.

The branch retains the exact upstream #7257 navigation and historical-replay fixes, with original authorship and cherry-pick provenance. Six navigation tests passed locally. The separate historical audit could not run in this local partial clone because its shared-clone operation could not obtain a promisor object; hosted CI must check that infrastructure repair. No hosted success is inferred from local results.

Complete predecessor sources and credit are retained: Clear1nsight #7274/#7244, dillona #7161/#7155, Rohan Arun #7156/#7113, and all inherited Ali Romman, CubeJerry, ToikY, DreamingOfClouds and other notices. Prepared by Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

Five framework assumptions remain: `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, `analytic_recovery`. Author-local or hosted scientific passes are not maintainer selection or independent human/formal acceptance. No selected record is changed. The retained fixed-profile packing relaxation has crossing in [0.00580766609709, 0.00580766609756]; it is a scoped upper bound, not a global optimum claim.
